title: Hearty Chewy Tunisian Citrusy Chicken Grill
description: A flavorful and refreshing one-pan dish featuring grilled chicken, preserved lemon, and cultured creme fraiche. Perfect for a weekend brunch or a casual dinner.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. In a small bowl, mix together cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breasts, then place them on the grill. Cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes. In a separate bowl, mix together preserved lemon, cultured creme fraiche, parsley, mint, lemon zest, and Tunisian chili flakes.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Add the chicken back to the grill and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until it's nicely charred and slightly crispy on the edges.
Transfer the chicken to a serving platter and spoon the preserved lemon-creme fraiche mixture over the top. Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
